items.title: Return signed mobile-work agreement to HR
items.quote: Wir bitten Sie, die unterschriebene Zusatzvereinbarung innerhalb von 10 Werktagen (Mo–Sa, ohne Feiertage) nach dem Datum dieses Schreibens an die Personalabteilung zurückzusenden.
items.computation: This is a private (employer) deadline, not an authority notice, so no Bekanntgabefiktion applies; the letter's own date is the start of the period. Period start: letter date 28.04.2026 (Tuesday). Under §187 Abs.1 BGB the day of the triggering event (28.04.2026) is not counted, so counting begins 29.04.2026. 'Werktage (Mo–Sa, ohne Feiertage)' = Monday to Saturday, excluding public holidays; Sundays and holidays are skipped and not counted. Counting workdays from 29.04.2026: 29.04 (Wed)=1, 30.04 (Thu)=2, 01.05 (Fri) = Tag der Arbeit, nationwide holiday, skipped, 02.05 (Sat)=3, 03.05 (Sun) skipped, 04.05 (Mon)=4, 05.05 (Tue)=5, 06.05 (Wed)=6, 07.05 (Thu)=7, 08.05 (Fri)=8, 09.05 (Sat)=9, 10.05 (Sun) skipped, 11.05 (Mon)=10. The 10th Werktag is Monday 11.05.2026. As this already falls on a working day (Monday, not a Sunday/holiday), no further shift under §193 BGB is needed.
